questions.question: Should the operator return true when every item in the input list is found in the reference list, and false otherwise?
questions.answer: Yes, return true when every input item is present in the reference list

questions.question: Should the comparison be case-insensitive for both lists and treat input as UTF-8 text strings?
questions.answer: No, preserve case and use exact string matching

questions.question: How should empty or null entries be handled if they appear in either list?
questions.answer: Ignore empty or null entries and compare only non-empty values
